Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Two follow-ups from our side:

1) We discovered the initial spend cap that was provisioned (USD 15k/month) is insufficient for our July/aug spike. Can you advise the fastest path to increase to USD 45k/month temporarily through Q4?

2) Our AP team says a handful of line items in the PO template are mis-coded — product SKUs 9-12 should be consolidated into a single line (SKU-EG-CORE) and the monthly quantity should be 3 instead of 12. We've attached the onboarding form and a suggested line list.

We need a PO number to get procurement moving; if there are any internal approvals needed please flag them and I'll loop in our finance lead.

Appreciate it — Liam

Attachment: EchoGrid_Onboard_Form.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: EchoGrid_PO_LineList.xlsx (xlsx)

Hi Liam — thanks for sending this over and for the clear line-item notes. Short update and asks from our side: 

- I'll kick off a temporary spend-cap increase request to Procurement for a short-term raise to USD 45k/month. That path typically needs sign-off from Finance (Marcus) and a confirmation that EchoGrid accepts a provisional PO before the formal contract is updated.
- Can your AP confirm the bill-to legal name matches the onboarding form ("EchoGrid, Inc.") and provide the tax ID so our finance team can finalize the PO header?

Next steps I'm proposing:
- Action: Naomi to request provisional PO number for spike (internal SLA: 24 hours)
- Action: EchoGrid to confirm tax ID and legal name (you)
- Action: Marcus to approve temporary cap change (cc'd)

I won't make the line consolidation change until Procurement issues the provisional PO so we have a clean trail. Will follow up as soon as Marcus confirms.

— Naomi
